Title: Relates to universal pre-kindergarten
Summary: Enacts the "fairness, user transparency, universal pre-kindergarten, and responsible exchange safeguards act" or the "futures act"; relates to prediction market consumer protection; establishes the futures fund for early education for the purpose of funding universal pre-kindergarten in the state; establishes taxes related to the use of prediction markets; relates to the use of prediction markets in furtherance of election violations.
LawCode: Add Art 48-A §§1820 - 1834, Gen Bus L; add §99-uu, St Fin L; add Art 15 §§330 - 334, §§698-a & 219-b, Tax L; add §17-172, El L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to prediction market consumer protection; to amend the state finance law, in relation to establishing the futures fund for early education; to amend the tax law, in relation to establishing taxes related to prediction market use; and to amend the election law, in relation to the use of prediction market platforms in furtherance of election violations
